PROGRAM
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "Users"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      SHAPE_EXPR
        IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      EXPR
        LITERAL_EXPR
          IDENT "User"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          AT_ATTR "@subject"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          UNARY_EXPR
            MINUS "-"
            UNARY_EXPR
              MINUS "-"
              LITERAL_EXPR
                IDENT "x"
